- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended the following books:
  1. **"All the Light We Cannot See" by Anthony Doerr**: Set during WWII, explores the lives of a blind French girl and a German boy.
  2. **"The Alice Network" by Kate Quinn**: Story of two women during WWI, exploring themes of female friendship and survival.
  3. **"The Women in the Castle" by Jessica Shattuck**: Follows three women during WWII navigating the aftermath of the war.
  4. **"Those Who Save Us" by Jenna Blum**: Explores the relationship between a mother and daughter during WWII.
  5. **"The Lost Girls of Paris" by Pam Jenoff**: Set in 1946, follows a young widow discovering a suitcase of photographs of women in a resistance network.
  6. **"The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society" by Mary Ann Shaffer**: An epistolary novel set after WWII about the experiences of islanders during the occupation.
